text:
Avery: Quick sync — planning cohort migration incentives & backstop playbook for model catalog onboarding. Need decisions on acceptance gates, pin TTL options, and migration credit mechanics. TL;DR: propose 3 lanes (fast, staged, enterprise), soft-pin window 30d, hard-deprecation 90d after notice, and credits for customers who cutover within 60d. Thoughts?

Diego: Sounds reasonable. Can you post the acceptance metrics? Also need runtime ops budget for staged canaries.

Priya: Add quality gate: embedding cosine drift <= 0.015 on customer holdouts OR prompt-sensitive precision thresholds. And A/B user-facing regressions < 1%.

Avery: Posted acceptance snippet below, please critique: 
```text
Lanes:
- fast: 7d onboarding, automated eval only
- staged: 30d canary, customer opt-in
- enterprise: custom SLA, manual review

Acceptance:
- text generation: p95 latency < 150ms (50-token baseline)
- embeddings: cosine drift < 0.015 on holdout sets
- regression: automated eval score >= baseline - 0.5 pts
```

Diego: Ops question: what about pin TTL behavior? soft-pin vs hard-pin? I prefer soft-pin where model stays pinned but becomes eligible for auto-swap after 30d unless customer opts out.

Sam: From sales — credits sound good. Also can we provide a migration checklist (one-pager) to reduce customer lift? That helps adoption.

Elena: CS: Need an escape hatch for big events — a "freeze window" for enterprise customers. Also propose notification cadence: initial notice, 30d, 14d, 7d, 1d.

Avery: Proposed timelines & comms: 
- Notice: day 0
- Auto-swap window: day 31-60 (customer still served but switched with opt-out)
- Hard retire: day 91

Priya: Metric hooks for rollback: if production latency increase > 20% or quality regression > 2% then auto rollback + page oncall. We should also log per-customer delta to check blast radius.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for catalog:v3 on region us-west at 2026-03-20T15:12Z :rocket:

Diego: Adding a suggested rollout policy config: 
```yaml
rollout:
  lanes: staged
  canary_percentages: [1, 10, 50]
  metric_alerts:
    latency_p95_increase_pct: 20
    quality_regression_pct: 2
```

Avery: Agree. Next steps: Priya to finalize eval thresholds by EOD Friday; Diego to scope infra cost + canary ops; Sam + Elena to draft customer comms + migration credits template. I’ll collate and send to exec on Monday. @Priya @Diego @Sam @Elena :thumbsup:

Priya: Will do. Sharing draft eval harness here: http://internal/benchmarks/cohort-evals

Sam: I’ll draft the one-pager and credit terms template.

Elena: Adding freeze-window flag to SRE runbook and will notify account teams.

Diego: I’ll post infra estimate by Friday noon.

Avery: Thanks all. I’ll open the RFC after we have numbers and the draft comms. /end
